mechanism: Both drugs can bind to divalent cations and form chelate complexes in the gastrointestinal tract, reducing absorption of risedronate; minocycline may also cause esophageal irritation compounding bisphosphonate-related effects.
action: Separate administration by at least 2 hours; instruct patient to take risedronate first with plain water on an empty stomach, then wait before taking minocycline with food to enhance minocycline absorption.
